craft_notes: Sthāyin: generation — womb to fruit. Rows: ways then bearing. Read aloud: sowing rhythm.

lines: In this outflow's home, by savoring — in these three ways alone —
mantra-might bears each fruit in every knowing-womb.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etad visargadhāmani parimarśanatas tridhaiva manuvīryam tattatsaṃvidgarbhe mantras tattatphalaṃ sūte
